populations.all90: metadata/occupations/HOMO/i_ekt only, no new AO/DM reconstruction
populations.SOURCE: original NPZ coords64, weights64, vxc64; regenerated AO on exact stored coordinates
populations.CORPUS: actual publication dataset coords/weights/vxc/source rows and cached phi F32 widened to F64; regenerated AO F64 only to check qualified RefAO

H_KS: hcore+J(total dm_ks)+projected vxc; no exchange,D3,nuclear repulsion or SCF
WF_counterfactual: only if SOURCE raw eigenpair fails declared resolution and original dm1_ao_wf is finite/symmetric/same AO dimension and electron-count consistent; hcore+J(dm1_ao_wf)+same Vxc; no density mixture

criteria.fit_roundoff_bound: 64eps64*nAO*cond(S)*max(1,||XFC||+||XSCeps||)/||DQ||; chunk-order fit difference also measured; does not bound unknown exporter error
criteria.consistent_classification: raw max orbital residual<=1e-4 Ha, MO/DM integrity PASS; report all bands, no machine-exact exporter claim
criteria.constant_classification: raw max fails, Q or S LS-adjusted max<=1e-4 Ha and fitted |c| exceeds arithmetic/1e-6 resolution; original raw FAIL remains

criterion_basis: existing corpus electron-count/orthogonality integrity contracts; eigenpair/EKT 1e-4 Ha is declared reporting resolution, not transferred density convergence, training threshold or exporter guarantee
IP_units: positive raw i_ekt retained; Hartree comparison prescribed by task and NPZ energy bundle. Original exporter has no unit annotation; do not replace missing/negative values
